name: Exact General Remeshing Scheme for Conservative Voxelization
aliases: Exact General Remeshing Scheme for Conservative Voxelization (2D)
definition: A voxelization method that classifies grid voxels into three types based on their intersection with a tetrahedron, clips boundary voxels using a graph-based traversal, and integrates polynomial density fields over the resulting clipped polyhedra via simplicial decomposition.
summary: This method voxelizes tetrahedra by computing physically conservative moments to ensure exact mass conservation, using planar graph representations to maintain topological consistency and avoid aliasing noise.
